name: lemma
description: Hand science and engineering work to Lemma: start a session or find and read an earlier one, send files, wait for the run, read the answer, download results, and open it in the browser.

open_browser.title: Open sessions in the browser
open_browser.description: Open each new session in your browser as soon as a message is sent.

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: The model a new session starts on when Claude names none. Type one of: Lemma's default, Anthropic Pro Fast, Anthropic Pro, Anthropic Normal, Google Pro, Google Normal, Open-weight Pro, or Open-weight Normal. Lemma's default is the model Lemma would use in the browser.

default_machine.title: Default machine
default_machine.description: The machine a new session runs on when Claude names none. Type one of: Standard, Enhanced, High performance, Max, or GPU.

max_tool_output_chars.title: Tool output cap
max_tool_output_chars.description: The most characters the tools that read sessions, plans and results return to Claude. A longer result is cut, and Claude can save the whole of it to a file instead.
